# DNS.usectl.com

> DNS.usectl.com is a zero-bloat, ad-free global DNS propagation checker and SSL certificate radar for developers, DevOps, and cloud engineers.
> Part of the usectl.com infrastructure suite.

## Quick Links
- Canonical Website: https://dns.usectl.com
- Full Documentation: https://dns.usectl.com/llms-full.txt
- Resolver Dataset: https://dns.usectl.com/data/resolvers.json
- Open Graph Preview: https://dns.usectl.com/og-image.png
- Parent Ecosystem: https://usectl.com

## Supported Record Types
- `A`: IPv4 host addresses
- `AAAA`: IPv6 host addresses
- `CNAME`: Canonical aliases
- `MX`: Mail exchange hosts with priority rankings
- `TXT`: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and domain ownership tokens
- `NS`: Authoritative nameservers
- `CAA`: Certificate Authority Authorization rules
- `SOA`: Start of Authority zones & serial numbers
- `PTR`: Reverse DNS pointer records

## Global Resolvers Queried in Parallel
- Cloudflare Anycast (1.1.1.1)
- Google Public DNS (8.8.8.8)
- Quad9 Anycast (9.9.9.9)
- OpenDNS / Cisco (208.67.222.222)
- Control D (US, UK, Germany, Tokyo, Sydney, São Paulo, Johannesburg)
- DNS.SB (Frankfurt, Singapore)
- AdGuard DNS (Amsterdam, VA)
- CIRA Canadian Shield (Toronto)
- AliDNS (Hangzhou)
- Mullvad (Stockholm)

## Key Technical Features
- Sub-200ms latency via concurrent client-side DoH (`application/dns-json`).
- Expected Value Diff Matcher: Highlights nodes serving stale cached records with remaining TTL.
- Zero-dependency SSL/TLS Inspector: Certificate expiration countdown, issuer, cipher suite, and TLS version.
- 1-click terminal commands: Instant `dig` and `nslookup` command generator.
